name: vecker
description: Vecker — Shabbos-mode alarm clock, zmanim, Jewish calendar, reminders and siddur. PWA + native iOS/Android via Capacitor. https://vecker.app

scripts.sync: npm run stage && npx cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run stage && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run stage && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.test: node test/store.test.mjs && node test/api.test.mjs && node test/sync.test.mjs
